items.t: Cathie Wood and 9 Other Big Funds Sold Roblox Last Quarter, While 8 Bought. Who’s Right?

items.t: Roblox Soars 9% as Oppenheimer Says GTA VI Hasn’t Dented Engagement, Lifts Target to $55
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRoblox shares jumped 9% after Oppenheimer raised its target to $55 from $50, saying GTA VI hasn’t materially hurt engagement. That eases the worry behind Roblox’s fourth-quarter guide, which built in a headwind from Take-Two Interactive’s GTA VI.
